text: A psalm. A song for the dedication of the Temple. [1] Of David.
I I praise you, Lord, for you raised me upand did not let my enemies rejoice over me.
O Lord, my God,I cried out to you for help and you healed [2] me.
Lord, you brought my soul up from Sheol;you let me live, from going down to the pit. [3] [AA]
II Sing praise to the Lord, you faithful;give thanks to his holy memory.
For his anger lasts but a moment;his favor a lifetime.At dusk weeping comes for the night;but at dawn there is rejoicing.
III Complacent, [4] I once said,"I shall never be shaken."
Lord, you showed me favor,established for me mountains of virtue.But when you hid your faceI was struck with terror. [AB]
To you, Lord, I cried out;with the Lord I pleaded for mercy:
t[5]"What gain is there from my lifeblood,from my going down to the grave?Does dust give you thanksor declare your faithfulness?
Hear, O Lord, have mercy on me;Lord, be my helper."
IV You changed my mourning into dancing;you took off my sackclothand clothed me with gladness. [AC]
So that my glory may praise youand not be silent.O Lord, my God,forever will I give you thanks.
